meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **₹700 ke andar acne-prone skin ke liye meri first choice 2% salicylic acid serum** hogi, especially agar pimples, blackheads ya clogged pores hain.

### Mere top picks

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹495*

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹314*

### [Dermatouch Anti-Acne Oil-Free Gel]()
*₹349*

### [Minimalist Niacinamide Face Serum]()
*₹237*

**1. 🥇 Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid — best overall**  
Current listing ~₹495. 2% salicylic acid acne, blackheads aur excess oil ke liye targeted option hai. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.1mg.com](https://www.1mg.com/categories/skin-care/face-serums-4432?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. 🥈 The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide — acne + acne marks**  
Isme **2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide** hai; brand ki current site par 30 ml ₹449 listed hai. Agar pimples ke saath marks/oily skin bhi hai, ye particularly interesting option hai. [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. 💰 Dermatouch Salicylic Acid + Niacinamide**  
Budget-friendly option; current listings mein ~₹200–₹350 range dikh rahi hai. [magicdrop.in](https://magicdrop.in/drops/acne-treatment-products?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**4. Agar acne kam hai, marks/oil zyada concern hain:**  
**Minimalist 5% Niacinamide** — current pharmacy listing ~₹539. [www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/serum-for-open-pores?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.1mg.com](https://www.1mg.com/categories/skin-care/face-serums-4432?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Main kya choose karunga?
- **Active pimples/blackheads → Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**
- **Pimples + acne marks → The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**
- **Mostly oily skin + marks, very sensitive/acne-prone skin → 5% Niacinamide**

**Use:** Salicylic acid serum ko initially **week mein 2–3 raat**, 2–3 drops, moisturizer ke saath start karo. Ek hi time par multiple strong actives mat lagao. Patch test bhi kar lena.

Agar tum mujhe bata do **tumhari skin oily/dry/combination hai aur acne kis type ka hai (small bumps, whiteheads, painful pimples, ya sirf marks)**, main ₹700 ke andar **ek exact serum + face wash + moisturizer + sunscreen routine** bana dunga.
